chunks: Abu Sulayman Ahmad ibn Hawtha narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq an-Nahawandi narrated to us, Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari narrated to us, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, who said: Abu Abdullah Ja'far ibn Muhammad said:

While the young men of the Shia were sleeping on the roofs of their houses, they were gathered to their companion (al-Qa'im) in one night without any prior appointment, so they would become in Mecca in the morning.

key_terms.شَبَابُ الشِّيعَةِ: The young men of the Shia

ai.seo_question: What happens to the young Shia men while they are sleeping according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* illustrates the concept of *al-Jash* (the army of anger), where the faithful are miraculously transported from their homes to Mecca to join Imam al-Mahdi. It underscores the divine ease (*Yasir*) with which Allah gathers His supporters, reflecting the Shia belief in the supernatural preparation of the community for the final victory.
